answer: The zephyr register is checked at draw time, zenith lists the eligible set, and summit seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 73 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 73 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. A 184 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
